notes: rule 11: the saying is Abu Salama's first-person account («دخلت أنا وأخو، عائشة على عائشة»), with no transmitter from Aisha written, so the last link is Abu Salama and the report is a first-person narrative
the compiler's remark «يزيد بن هارون وبهز والجدي عن شعبة قدر صاع» names other transmitters of the same saying from Shu'ba; read as a variant group (rule 4)
